{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season | year = 2019–20 | team = Minnesota Golden Gophers | sport = basketball | logo = Minnesota Golden Gophers logo.svg | logo_size = | logo_alt = | image = | image_size = | image_alt = | conference = Big Ten Conference | short_conf = Big Ten | CoachRank = | APRank = | record = 15–16 | conf_record = 8–12 | head_coach = [[Richard Pitino]] | hc_year = 7th | asst_coach1 = [[Ed Conroy (basketball)|Ed Conroy]] | ac1_year = 4th | asst_coach2 = [[Rob Jeter]] | ac2_year = 2nd | asst_coach3 = Kyle Lindsted | ac3_year = 2nd | captain = | captain_year = | arena = [[Williams Arena]] | champion = | tourney = | tourney_result = }} {{2019–20 Big Ten Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2019–20 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Minnesota]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Gophers were led by seventh-year head coach [[Richard Pitino]] and played their home games at [[Williams Arena]] in [[Minneapolis|Minneapolis, Minnesota]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. They finished the season 15–16, 8–12 in [[2019–20 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in 12th place. The Gophers defeated [[2019–20 Northwestern Wildcats men's basketball team|Northwestern]] in the first round of the [[2020 Big Ten men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]]{{Cite web|title=Northwestern vs. Minnesota - Game Recap - March 11, 2020 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401211003|access-date=2020-06-25|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} before the tournament was canceled due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.{{Cite web|last=Solari|first=Chris|title=March Madness cancellation inevitable, unavoidable: 'Bigger than basketball'|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/college/2020/03/12/coronavirus-ncaa-tournament-canceled-big-ten/5038937002/|access-date=2020-06-25|website=Detroit Free Press|language=en}} All other postseason tournaments including the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] were later canceled effectively ending the season.{{Cite web|first=Steve |last=Almasy|title=The NCAA is canceling March Madness|url=https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/12/us/march-madness-withdrawals-spt/index.html|access-date=2020-06-25|website=CNN}}{{Cite web|title=2020 NCAA Tournament canceled due to growing threat of coronavirus pandemic|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/2020-ncaa-tournament-canceled-due-to-growing-threat-of-coronavirus-pandemic/|access-date=2020-06-25|website=CBSSports.com|language=en}} ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Golden Gophers]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 22–14, 9–11 in [[2018–19 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in seventh place. As the No. 7 seed in the [[2019 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they defeated [[2018–19 Penn State Nittany Lions men's basketball team|Penn State]] in the second round.{{Cite web|url=http://www.startribune.com/gophers-shake-off-slow-start-to-force-overtime-beat-penn-state-in-big-ten-basketball-tournament/507176832/|title=Gophers shake off slow start to force overtime, beat Penn State in Big Ten basketball tournament|website=Star Tribune|access-date=2019-06-26}} In the quarterfinals, they defeated [[2018–19 Purdue Boilermakers men's basketball team|Purdue]] for the second time on the season.{{Cite web|url=https://www.jconline.com/story/sports/college/purdue/basketball/2019/03/15/purdue-basketball-falls-minnesota-big-ten-tournament-quarters/3171200002/|title=Minnesota knocks Purdue basketball out of Big Ten tournament|website=Journal & Courier|language=en|access-date=2019-06-26}} In the semifinals, they lost to [[2018–19 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/university-michigan/2019/03/16/live-updates-michigan-vs-minnesota-big-ten-tournament/3184696002/|title=Recap: Michigan rolls over Minnesota, will play Michigan State in Big Ten final|website=Detroit News|language=en|access-date=2019-06-26}} The Gophers received a bid to the [[2019 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 10 seed in the East Region. There, they defeated seventh-seeded [[2018–19 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401123436|title=Minnesota vs. Louisville - Game Recap - March 21, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-06-26}} in the first round before losing to [[2018–19 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] in the second round.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401123439|title=Minnesota vs. Michigan State - Game Recap - March 23, 2019 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-06-26}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
